# Credits

T3 Craft exists because of other people's work. This page lists every project, font, build, mod and name it uses, who made it, and the license it comes under. The mod itself is [MIT](https://github.com/alexandros-lekkas/t3craft/blob/main/LICENSE).

> **Built on [maxwellyoung/t3craft](https://github.com/maxwellyoung/t3craft) by Maxwell Young.** The mod itself. T3 Craft started as Maxwell's project: the in-game T3 panel, threads, approvals and the agent village began there.

**Contents:** [Code](#code) · [Builds & schematics](#builds--schematics) · [Art](#art) · [Minecraft imagery](#minecraft-imagery) · [Modpack](#modpack) · [Trademarks](#trademarks) · [Services](#services) · [Disclaimers](#disclaimers)

## Code

### [T3 Craft (original project)](https://github.com/maxwellyoung/t3craft)

**By** Maxwell Young · **License** [MIT](https://github.com/maxwellyoung/t3craft/blob/main/LICENSE)

- **Used for:** The mod itself. T3 Craft started as Maxwell's project: the in-game T3 panel, threads, approvals and the agent village began there.
- **Changes:** Forked and extended by Alexandros Lekkas and contributors: MCP tools, the shared office, agent characters, the laptop, the panel redesign, the modpack and the docs. The upstream copyright notice is kept in LICENSE.

### [T3 Craft (this fork)](https://github.com/alexandros-lekkas/t3craft)

**By** Alexandros Lekkas and contributors · **License** [MIT](https://github.com/alexandros-lekkas/t3craft/blob/main/LICENSE)

- **Used for:** Everything added since the fork, under the same MIT license.

### [Fabric Loader](https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric-loader)

**By** FabricMC · **License** [Apache 2.0](https://spdx.org/licenses/Apache-2.0.html)

- **Used for:** Mod loader T3 Craft runs on. Not bundled; installed by the launcher.

### [Gson](https://github.com/google/gson)

**By** Google · **License** [Apache 2.0](https://spdx.org/licenses/Apache-2.0.html)

- **Used for:** JSON for the T3 protocol and MCP. Provided by Minecraft's own classpath; not bundled.

### [Brigadier](https://github.com/Mojang/brigadier)

**By** Mojang Studios · **License** [MIT](https://spdx.org/licenses/MIT.html)

- **Used for:** The /t3 chat commands. Provided by Minecraft; not bundled.

## Minecraft imagery

### [Minecraft textures, world generation and seeds](https://www.minecraft.net)

**By** Mojang Studios / Microsoft · **License** [Minecraft Usage Guidelines](https://www.minecraft.net/usage-guidelines)

- **Used for:** Screenshots, office renders and seed maps in the README, docs and launch kit. Vanilla textures appear only inside these images; T3 Craft does not ship any Mojang assets. World seeds are numbers that Minecraft turns into terrain.
